about.title: A balanced approach
about.p1: Fatema interprets dreams with a scholarly method based on Islamic teaching, without exaggeration and without causing fear. We believe dreams are messages from God. Some bring good news and comfort; others bring a warning. We work hard to give a deep and realistic reading of their symbols.
about.p2: This site is for interpreting dreams on sound foundations from the Quran and the Sunnah of the Prophet. It links dream interpretation with calling people to Allah, in a simple and short way.
about.p3: Since I started this work, I have seen that the people most interested in dreams are often the ones facing the hardest trials. So I made episodes about true happiness, which is being close to Allah, and which leads to happiness in the Hereafter.
about.verse: “And who is better in speech than one who calls to Allah, does good, and says: I am one of the Muslims.”
about.bullet1: Over 11 years of interpreting dreams, by God’s grace, based on the Quran and Sunnah.
about.bullet2: A researcher in the science of dream interpretation.

terms.intro: Welcome to Saadat Al-Darain. The site offers dream interpretation by Interpreter Fatema. By using the site and creating an account, you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully.

p: A dream interpretation is a considered opinion based on the known principles of interpretation from the Quran, the Sunnah and the scholars. It can be right or wrong. It is not knowledge of the unseen and it does not say for certain what will happen.
An interpretation does not replace a doctor, therapist, lawyer or financial adviser. Do not make a major decision based on it alone.
You sign in with your email and password, or with Google. We store your password only as a one-way encrypted hash, so no one can read it.
Enter your real name, gender and date of birth. The interpreter uses them to understand your dream. The site detects your country from your internet connection.
You are responsible for keeping your email, your password and your signed-in devices safe. You can review and sign out devices from My account.
If you are under 18, use the site with your parent's or guardian's knowledge and consent.
One credit is one dream interpretation.
Prices are shown in your country's currency. The site decides the country and the price.
A credit is used when you send a dream for interpretation, not when you save a draft.

Credits from each package stay valid for the period shown on it when you buy it, which is 12 months from the payment date unless stated otherwise. Credits not used within that period expire and are not refunded.
When you send a dream, the credit that expires soonest is used first, and your account shows when your credits will expire before they do.

Payment is handled by an approved payment provider. The site never sees or stores your card details. An order may be reviewed before credits are added if the payment country differs from the country you were shown prices for.
A credit used for a dream that has been interpreted cannot be refunded.
For a payment problem or a refund request, email our support address from the email you use to sign in.
Type the invoice number in your message, as shown in your payment receipt email or on the Payments page, describe the problem briefly, and attach screenshots or proof.
We review every complete request and reply with a decision as soon as possible, within 2 working days.
See the Refund policy page for full details of what can and cannot be refunded.
You see the expected reply time before you send a dream, and again in the confirmation email.
The interpreter may ask you a question to understand the dream better. The reply-time clock stops until you answer.
Write your own dream, honestly.
Do not include other people's personal details, and do not write offensive or improper content.
We may suspend any account that misuses the site.
We may ask for your review after the interpretation. A review is only published after the interpreter approves it. It shows your first name only and never shows your dream.
Your interpretation is yours for personal use, and you can download it from your dream page.
The site's design, text and the channel's videos belong to their owners. Do not copy them for commercial use without permission.
These terms and every transaction on the site are governed by the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt.
The Egyptian courts have jurisdiction over any dispute, after first trying to settle it amicably through our support email.
We may update these terms when needed, and the date at the top of this page shows the last update. If you keep using the site after an update, you accept it.

privacy.intro: Your privacy matters to us. This page explains what data we collect, why, who can see it, and how you control it.

p: Account details: name, email, gender, date of birth, language and country.
Your dreams: the dream text, the interpretation and the messages between you and the interpreter.

Orders and payments: package, amount, currency, country, payment status, the payment provider's transaction number and the card's issuing country. We never store your card number or any other card details.
Devices: browser, operating system, country and sign-in time, so we can show your devices and warn you about a sign-in from a new device.
Page visits: page name, device type, country and the site you came from, with a random session number that does not identify you.
Browser notifications, if you turn them on.
To interpret your dreams. The interpreter sees your age, gender and country because they help her understand the dream.
To send emails and notifications about your dreams and your account.
To email you when a new video is published on the interpreter's channel.
To show the right price for your country.
To protect your account and prevent misuse.
For overall visit statistics that do not identify anyone.
Only you and the interpreter. Dreams are never published, and your data is never sold or used for advertising.

We do not store your IP address with your visits or your devices. We use it for a moment to find your country and to block misuse. It is only stored with requests for the codes we email you (sign-in, new account and password reset codes), for security.
Google: for Google sign-in and to load the site's fonts.
Cloudflare: to protect the site and detect your country.
The payment provider: to process payments. It receives only your name, email and country.
Email and browser notification services: to deliver messages to you.
The hosting companies that run the site.
One cookie keeps you signed in, and no page can read it.
Local storage for your sign-in, language and theme.
We do not use any advertising or commercial tracking tools.
You can delete your account from My account. When you do, we remove your name, email, sign-in methods and notification subscription, and sign you out on every device.
We keep the records of dreams and payments for accounting, linked to an account that no longer has your name or email.
You can ask for a copy of your data, or ask us to correct or delete it, by emailing our support address.

refund.intro: We want you to buy with peace of mind. This page explains when you get your money back, when you do not, and how to ask.

p: If you paid and the credits were not added to your account, we add them or refund the full amount, whichever you choose.
If you were charged more than once for the same order, we refund the extra charge in full.
If you have not used any credit from a package and you ask within 14 days of payment, we refund its full price.
If your dream is cancelled before it is interpreted, its credit goes back to your account automatically so you can use it for another dream.
A credit used for a dream that has been interpreted.
Expired credits. Credits are valid for 12 months from the payment date unless stated otherwise when you buy.

sections.h: How to ask for a refund
p: Email our support address from the email you use to sign in, or call us during the support hours shown on the Contact us page.
Type the invoice number, as shown in your payment receipt email or on the Payments page, describe the problem briefly, and attach screenshots or proof.

sections.h: Review and when the money arrives
p: We review every complete request and reply with a decision within 2 working days.
Once approved, the money goes back to the same payment method you used, through the payment provider.
It usually arrives within 5 to 14 working days, depending on your bank or wallet.
When a refund is approved, the matching credits are removed from your account.
